build_transformer_layer: build a TransformerLayer with multihead attention, feed-forward network, and pre-layer normalization for ESM protein models
build_axial_transformer_layer: build an AxialTransformerLayer with row and column self-attention blocks for MSA transformer protein models
create_contact_prediction_head: create a ContactPredictionHead that applies symmetrization and APC to attention weights for protein contact prediction
create_positional_embedding: create a LearnedPositionalEmbedding or SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module to encode sequence position into protein embeddings
create_roberta_lm_head: create a RobertaLMHead for masked language modeling that projects features back to vocabulary size with tied weights
